# Croud

> > Croud is a global performance marketing agency specializing in paid search, retail media, SEO, and data-driven digital strategies across platforms including Google, TikTok, Amazon, and emerging retail channels.

Croud combines proprietary technology with the Croudie freelancer network to deliver integrated marketing solutions for clients ranging from luxury brands to restaurant chains like First Watch. The agency focuses on evidence-based approaches to SEO, first-party data strategies, and AI-driven creative optimization while maintaining expertise in E-E-A-T principles and GDPR compliance.

## Key Topics

- Performance marketing
- Paid search (PPC)
- Retail media (Amazon, Walmart, TikTok Shop)
- First-party data strategies
- Third-party cookie deprecation
- E-E-A-T (Experience, Expertise, Authoritativeness, Trustworthiness)
- Google Analytics 4 (GA4/GA360)
- Croudie freelancer network
- Luxury brand marketing
- SEO and organic performance
- Social commerce
- Consumer behavior trends
- AI-driven creative optimization
- GDPR compliance
- Omnichannel marketing
